mapper.sql: flt02_emp_id AS emp_id , flt02_start_date AS start_date , flt02_year_invest_limit AS year_invest_limit , flt02_check_cycle AS check_cycle , f_cdnm('FloorTrCheckCycle', flt02_check_cycle, flt02_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS check_cycle_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flt02_emp (flt02_emp_id, flt02_company_id, flt02_person_id, flt02_start_date, flt02_year_invest_limit, flt02_check_cycle) VALUES (#{id}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{startDate}, #{yearInvestLimit}, #{checkCycle})
mapper.select: SELECT flt04_appr_id AS appr_id , apr01_status_cd AS status_code , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) AS status_name FROM flt04_oath LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON flt04_appr_id = apr01_appr_id WHERE 1=1 AND flt04_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt04_person_id = #{personId} ORDER BY flt04_start_date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flt04_oath (flt04_oath_id, flt04_company_id, flt04_person_id, flt04_start_date, flt04_appr_id, flt04_use_yn) SELECT f_create_seq(), #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{regDate}, #{apprId}, 'true'
